target_customer: Brands, agencies and publishers buying and running 360 degree video ads
problem: 360 and VR content had no distribution; ads needed to work in a mobile browser without a headset or app.
business_model: Ad platform taking a share of 360 ad spend and sold through exchanges

founders.name: Brad Phaisan
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/CEO with no background.

founders.name: Michael Rucker
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch 2016 says he previously headed content strategy at YouTube.

technical_complexity.rationale: Serving 360 video in mobile browsers via HTML5 and VAST across many publisher environments was a standard but fiddly engineering task.

defensibility.rationale: Publisher and exchange integrations helped, but Facebook and YouTube launched native 360 formats in 2015 and 2016.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: YouTube unveiled 360 video in March 2015 and Facebook added 360 video and ads by 2016; the company was later reported as acquired by Meta in 2020.

market_need_then: From 2015 VR and 360 video attracted advertiser interest; Immersv and VirtualSky also targeted VR ads by 2016, and OmniVirt's differentiator was running in the browser.

rebrands.why: Not stated; TechCrunch 2016 says it was previously known as AdsOptimal, and the name matches the later VR focus.

branding.community_and_virality: Press coverage on campaigns with Disney, GE and the New York Times; no fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press knew it as a 360 ad vendor, but searches found no brand-specific coverage.

pivots.why: Not stated by sources; the 360 product was in market by 2015 to 2016.

outcome_analysis: OmniVirt began as AdsOptimal in 2012 with a 500K dollar seed from top investors, then pivoted into 360 degree and VR advertising and ran campaigns for GE, Infiniti and Disney. It reportedly reached 1 million dollars of revenue by 2019 and was acquired by Meta in 2020, but the acquisition rests on a single aggregator and the price is unknown.
notes: omnivirt.com returned HTTP 503. The Meta acquisition (2020-06) is from CB Insights only, plus a mention that a Wikipedia Meta acquisitions list has a row (not verified), so treat as unverified. Seed date conflicts: PitchBook 2012-10, Seedtable 2013-01; only the year is used. The 500K amount comes from AdExchanger and Signalbase. Dated competitors near 2012 do not exist because the 360 product came later (competitors Immersv and VirtualSky are from a 2016 article), so the list is empty. Founder backgrounds beyond Rucker not found.
